jobs.title: Associate Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a fleet management leader and Lyft subsidiary, the company extends its expertise into autonomous vehicle infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. The Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. This role exists because one Operations Manager cannot provide the people leadership, floor coverage, and operational bandwidth a 24/7 depot of this scale requires.

The Associate Operations Manager carries ownership across two critical business workstreams: workforce scheduling support and process standards compliance. Fleet Operations Leads report to the Operations Manager — but during mid shifts, the Associate Operations Manager is the operational authority on the floor, directing their work, setting the quality standard, and serving as their most experienced resource and mentor.

This is a management role with a floor orientation. The Associate Operations Manager is present, coaching, directing, and executing alongside the team — while simultaneously carrying business responsibilities that directly impact depot readiness and partner compliance. This role is the bridge between the Fleet Operations Lead layer and the Operations Manager.

Responsibilities:

- Scheduling & Workforce Planning Support

- Owns the depot schedule — building, maintaining, and adjusting shift coverage across all teams to ensure the depot is consistently staffed and operationally ready.

- Monitors attendance, manages real-time coverage gaps, and proactively addresses workforce trends before they become operational problems.

- Partners with the Operations Manager on workforce planning, surfacing scheduling risks and recommendations with enough lead time to act.

- Training Program Execution & Certification Compliance

- Owns the planning and coordination of training program execution across all shift teams — ensuring Fleet Operations Associates and Fleet Operations Leads are scheduled, prepared, and on track to complete required partner certifications, safety refreshers, and qualification renewals.

- Maintains certification and qualification records for the team, flagging upcoming renewals and escalating compliance risks to the Operations Manager before they become audit findings.

- Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.

- Floor Execution & Quality Standards

- Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.

- Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts — directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets.

- Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards — inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team.

- Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.

- Fleet Operations Lead Mentorship & Operational Direction

- Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift — task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations.

- Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.

Experience:

- 5+ years of progressive experience in operational leadership, with a strong understanding of autonomous vehicle (AV) or complex fleet operational environments.

- Proven track record of launching and scaling new operational sites or programs, including accountability for facilities,  team performance, and operational outcomes.

- Demonstrated expertise in safety management and regulatory compliance within transportation, automotive, or similar regulated industries.

- Experience executing incident response and coordinating multi-vendor support in complex operational environments.

- Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, to effectively support and lead a 24/7 AV depot operation.

- Exceptional leadership in training execution and team development, with the ability to lead high-performing teams in safety-critical operations at scale.

- Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable decisions and surface clear recommendations to leadership.

- Demonstrated leadership ability in fast-paced, high-accountability environments, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to drive cross-functional alignment and lead on-site operations.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.

Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

- Subsidized commuter benefits

- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Note : For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.

This role is on-site at a Lyft Flexdrive hub or office location full time. #Onsite

The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is $88,560 - $110,700, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

Flexdrive is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. Flexdrive also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Flexdrive will also consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: AV Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive, Lyft's wholly-owned fleet management subsidiary, is undergoing a transformational shift from traditional rideshare fleet operations to autonomous vehicle fleet ownership and operations. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.

This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. You will work closely with workstream leads across Operations, Strategy, Infrastructure, Finance,  Legal, Analytics, and People.

If you thrive in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex multi-workstream programs, and have a bias toward action, this role is for you.

Responsibilities:

1. Program Planning & Execution

- Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal.

- Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross-functional blockers with clear context for escalation.

- Support weekly leadership syncs and monthly deep-dive reviews, including preparation, presentation and follow-through.

- Translate upstream decisions (partner agreements, market selections, ) into operational requirements, updating the readiness roadmap accordingly.

2. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Serve as a connection point between workstream leads, helping ensure infrastructure timelines align with hiring plans, capital deployment schedules match construction milestones, and fleet operations readiness tracks to vehicle delivery dates.

- Act as the central hub across cross-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution

- Coordinate with People and Operations to help sequence hiring, training, and certification programs ahead of vehicle arrivals.

- Work with FP&A and Treasury to track investment spend against the capital deployment schedule and flag variance early.

3. Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

- Build and deliver clear status reporting to program leadership and workstream stakeholders.

- Ensure cross-functional stakeholders stay aligned on expectations, deliverables, and timelines throughout the program.

- Maintain market readiness scorecards that provide visibility into each market's progress against deployment milestones.

- Create and maintain program documentation including decision logs, meeting notes, and workstream status trackers.

4. Process Support & Operational Excellence

- Help design and implement the program management operating model for AV readiness

- Identify and build process improvements across workstreams, using data to help optimize timelines and resource allocation.

- Build repeatable playbooks for market readiness that scale

Experience:

- 5 years of experience in program management, business operations, or a similar cross-functional role, ideally within high-growth tech, fleet management, logistics, or infrastructure-heavy environments

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate operational detail into clear updates for cross-functional stakeholders

- Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple workstreams, and adapting whatever program management tools or frameworks the situation calls for

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve

- Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to organize effective working groups and resolve conflicts around program processes and goals.

- Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, quantify trade-offs, and recommend courses of action with imperfect information.

- Preferred

- Experience preparing materials for and presenting to senior leaders

- Experience with infrastructure buildout programs (depot construction, facility standup, real estate development).

- Background in capital intensive projects, fleet management, automotive, mobility, or autonomous vehicle operations.

- Experience managing programs that span domestic and international markets.

- Experience in a subsidiary or business unit operating within a larger corporate parent.

Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

- Subsidized commuter benefits

- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. jobs.title: Legal Operations Program Manager, M&A Integrations
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We are looking for a high-impact Legal Operations Program Manager to join our expanding Legal Operations Team and sit at the center of our mergers & acquisitions (M&A) activity! This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies’ legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. To be clear, this is a business and organizational M&A integration role, not a systems or technology integration role. You will serve as the operating backbone for Legal across our most strategic transactions, owning the legal workstream of M&A integration in partnership with Lyft’s Corporate Development Integration Management Office (IMO), along with the intake and governance layer that connects the Legal team to deal work. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, proactive, and able to drive outcomes across multiple concurrent acquisitions in ambiguous, high-stakes environments with a collaborative and transparent approach. Some key areas include: M&A integration program management, program leadership across concurrent deals, cross-functional and deal team engagement, outside counsel and vendor management across jurisdictions, legal entity management and governance, and building a repeatable M&A integration operating model that scales with company growth. This position reports to the Head of Legal Operations.

As the company scales, the volume and complexity of strategic transactions — acquisitions, cross-border expansion, and new market entry — continues to increase. This role establishes a centralized operating model for the legal side of M&A integration that ensures:

- Acquisitions are integrated into Lyft Legal with discipline, completeness, and a clear critical path

- Legal is embedded early in each deal, from diligence through post-close, with strong planning-to-execution across multiple teams to deliver strong business results and manage risk

- The organization scales without inheriting unmanaged legal, contractual, or compliance risk from acquired companies

Responsibilities:

- M&A Integration Program Management

- Own the legal workstream of M&A integration across global acquisitions, from integration planning during diligence through post-close, in partnership with Corporate Development’s Integration Management Office (IMO)

- Build legal M&A integration roadmaps with clear dependencies and critical path, covering people, entities, contracts, matters, and compliance obligations, and stand up governance, reporting, and escalation frameworks for each acquisition

- Prepare and lead leadership readouts on the legal integration status of each acquisition in scope

- Track the retirement of inherited legal risk and post-close obligations, and codify repeatable legal M&A integration playbooks to improve speed, quality, and predictability

- Program Leadership & Execution

- Act as the control tower across concurrent acquisitions, ensuring legal integration work is resourced, sequenced, and prioritized appropriately across teams

- Build and manage integrated plans, milestones, and KPIs, and drive execution across multiple complex, cross-functional deal workstreams simultaneously

- Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, holding teams accountable while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships

- Maintain high-quality documentation, decision logs, and scalable processes

- Cross-Functional Engagement & Deal Support

- Partner across Corporate Development, Finance, People, Tax, Security, and the business to understand each deal’s integration plan and identify impacts on the Legal team’s people, processes, and organization

- Support diligence and signing-to-close workstreams, including data room logistics, tracking conditions to close, and managing transaction document repositories

- Coordinate a hub-and-spoke model that maps acquired legal team members, contracts, and matters to the appropriate Lyft Legal functional owners, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early

- Support the organizational integration of acquired legal teams, including role mapping, reporting lines, onboarding, and adoption of Lyft Legal policies and ways of working

- Outside Counsel / Vendor Management

- Work cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, and Accounting to manage outside counsel and vendor relationships for deal and post-acquisition matters, including engagement agreements, alternative fee arrangements, associated budgets, compliance with billing guidelines, and related internal and external communications

- Rationalize the acquired company’s outside counsel and legal vendor relationships against Lyft’s panel and billing guidelines, and manage multi-jurisdictional and cross-border engagements (including U.S., UK, EU, and Nordic counsel)

- Partner closely with our Legal Operations eBilling Specialist to transition acquired matters and spend onto Lyft’s e-Billing and matter management processes

- Entity Management & Governance

- Support legal entity integration, rationalization, registered agent and entity management, corporate housekeeping, and governance harmonization for newly acquired entities

- Partner with Corporate, Tax, and Finance to maintain accurate entity records and ensure post-close compliance and reporting obligations are met

- Operating Model, Technology & Reporting

- Help stand up and evolve the Legal M&A integration operating model, defining best practices for integration governance, intake, and cross-functional operating rhythms — introducing structure without slowing teams down

- Own the intake and prioritization layer for legal M&A integration work, defining criteria (impact, risk, effort, strategic alignment), providing pipeline visibility, and facilitating prioritization discussions with Legal leadership

- Develop, implement, and iterate on metrics, benchmarking, and dashboards that measure integration progress for each acquisition, legal spend, and the Legal team’s performance and efficiency

Experience:

- A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferred

- At least 6+ years of experience in legal operations, BizOps, program management, or consulting, with direct experience in post-merger / post-acquisition integration or large-scale M&A program management

- Excellent written and communication skills, with executive presence and the ability to drive clarity across senior stakeholders

- Understanding of financial management principles, including deal budgets and integration cost tracking

- Experience supporting corporate transactions, due diligence, and post-close integration of acquired companies, ideally in partnership with an Integration Management Office (IMO)

- Familiarity with cross-border and multi-jurisdictional matters; European experience a plus

- Ability to operate in ambiguity and drive outcomes in high-stakes, fast-moving environments

- Strong organizational thinking — understanding how people, processes, and obligations connect when two companies come together

- Strong business partnering skills with a commitment to professionalism, collegiality, and transparency

- Proactive entrepreneurial approach to recognizing needs, solving problems, anticipating issues and developing solutions

- Sense of ownership and exceptional follow through skills are absolutely essential

- Experience leading change management for teams adopting new processes, policies, and tools

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several projects and concurrent acquisitions simultaneously

- Comfortable facing new challenges, ambiguity, and changes in direction; flexibility in embracing frequent change

- Experience with Onit, Legal Tracker, Ironclad, Evisort, Tonkean, or equivalent tools, and Google Suite, a plus

Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- 401(k) plan to help save for your future

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

- Subsidized commuter benefits

- Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $132,000 - $165,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, AV Depot
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a leader in fleet management and a Lyft subsidiary, we're extending our expertise into autonomous vehicle (AV) infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep AV fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. Our Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion, and we're building the leadership team to sustain and scale it.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, AV Operations you'll be instrumental in owning and evolving the operational playbooks for our AV operations. You'll act as the primary operational leader , responsible for creating the strategic framework, executing complex projects, and ensuring the seamless functioning of our AV support infrastructure in close partnership with our AV technology partners.

This role is for a  hands-on leader with a unique blend of strategic foresight, project management excellence, and deep operational knowledge within the AV or complex fleet management space. If you thrive in ambiguous environments, are adept at building from the ground up, and possess the business acumen to drive efficiency and scalability, enabling our AV operations to thrive, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

- Execution & Site Management

- Daily Operational Execution: Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.

- Operational Resource Management: Manage operational resources (equipment, technology, consumables, staffing) efficiently on a daily basis to ensure maximum uptime and operational readiness.

- Technology Utilization: Execute operational procedures using necessary technologies and tools to enable efficient AV operations within the depot environment.

- Operational Excellence & Management

- Site Leadership: Serve as the primary operational head for the AV depot, driving daily performance, hands-on problem-solving, and ensuring adherence to all operational and safety protocols.

- Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for depot operations (e.g., vehicle uptime, turnaround time, maintenance efficiency, cost per vehicle) and swiftly address operational bottlenecks.

- Process Execution & Refinement: Execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and safety protocols for all aspects of AV fleet management within the depot environment. Identify practical improvements and roll them out to the team.

- Floor Presence: Maintain a strong floor presence, leading by example and directly supporting the team during peak operational periods or complex troubleshooting events.

- Stakeholder, Partner & Team Collaboration

- Team Management & Enablement: Manage the AV operators and technicians, handling scheduling, performance management, training, and fostering a positive, safety-first culture on the shop floor.

- Partner Relationship Management: Work closely with our AV technology partners on the ground, ensuring their operational needs are met and collaborating on joint initiatives for fleet health and performance.

- Vendor Execution : Oversee daily interactions with external vendors and partners for equipment, services, and facility needs.

- Regulatory & Compliance: Enforce all operations guidelines to adhere to local, state, and federal regulations for autonomous vehicles, commercial fleet management, and workplace safety.

Experience:

- 5+ years of progressive experience in site management, general management, or operational leadership, with a strong understanding of complex fleet management, logistics, or autonomous vehicle (AV) operations.

- Proven track record of managing established operational sites, with a focus on executing playbooks, driving daily efficiency, and managing physical infrastructure.

- Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, to effectively support and lead a 24/7 AV depot operation.

- Exceptional people management skills, including proficiency in shift scheduling, performance management, and building a strong safety and operational culture.

- Highly analytical and practical mindset, capable of interpreting daily performance data to drive immediate improvements in efficiency and productivity.

- Demonstrated leadership ability in fast-paced operational environments, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to lead on-site teams.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

- Subsidized commuter benefits

- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Note : For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.

Flexdrive highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. jobs.description:

The autonomous transition is a transformational opportunity for Lyft. Our strategy focuses on becoming the preferred marketplace, fleet, and operational partner for the world's best Autonomous Vehicle (AV) providers. As AV deployments scale across new markets, the operational infrastructure that enables safe, compliant, and high-quality service becomes a critical competitive advantage. This role sits at the heart of that infrastructure - owning the systems, processes, and partner alignment that allow Lyft to operate at the standards our AV partners require and our riders expect.

As a qualified candidate, you have a track record of building and running complex operational programs in highly regulated or standards-driven environments. You are energized by cross-functional complexity - comfortable leading structured implementation processes that span many teams while keeping a clear eye on compliance and quality outcomes. You bring a program management mindset, strong stakeholder communication skills, and the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving industry.

jobs.title: Repair Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a leader in fleet management and a Lyft subsidiary, we're extending our expertise into autonomous vehicle (AV) infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep AV fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. Our Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion, and we're building the team to sustain and scale it.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Deployment, Flexdrive is seeking an exceptional Repair Operations Lead to help run the day-to-day service operations supporting our AV fleet. You'll work alongside a second Repair Operations Lead as a partnered pair, sharing coverage and accountability for the floor. This is a people-first leadership role. You will lead and mentor our repair coordinators, hold both the coordinator team and our on-site technicians (a 3rd party partner) accountable to quality and turnaround expectations, and keep the partnership running smoothly so the fleet stays available.

We're looking for a strong people leader rather than a deep technical expert. Service advisor or service drive experience is helpful because you'll be fluent in the workflow, but what matters most is your ability to develop a team, set clear expectations, and hold the line on them without losing the room. You should be comfortable managing an external partner relationship day to day, balancing a collaborative working rapport with firm accountability. You bring a teamwork mentality, genuinely care about employee relations and the culture you're building, and will lean into Lyft's values as one of the early leaders shaping how this site operates. If you're energized by growing people, building strong partner relationships, and bringing order to a fast-moving operation, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

- Shift Pattern

- This role supports 24/7 AV depot operations and requires availability to work day shifts, with hours scheduled between 5:00 PM - 1:30 AM, with alternating weekends with rotating weekdays off.

- Specific shift times and schedules will be determined based on operational needs and business requirements.

- Schedules will include weekends and holidays based on depot operational requirements.

- Technical Team Management

- Partnership Oversight & Accountability: Serve as the day-to-day point of accountability for our onsite repair partner, holding their technicians to agreed quality, turnaround, and certification standards across all shifts, and escalating gaps through the right channels before they affect fleet availability.

- Workflow Distribution: Manage and optimize repair workflows across technician teams, balancing workload, prioritizing critical repairs, and ensuring SLA compliance for all maintenance activities.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with the internal teams that own our third-party relationships and offsite collision repairs, acting as the site-level point of contact so vehicles route correctly, status stays visible, and repair timelines hold. You'll surface issues from the floor to those teams and carry their requirements back to the site so both sides stay aligned.

- Performance Management: Conduct regular performance reviews, skills assessments, and development planning for technical staff, fostering a culture of safety, continuous improvement and technical excellence.

- Team Development & Coaching

- Onboarding & Job Task Training: Get new repair coordinators up to speed on their core responsibilities — work order management, vehicle intake and staging, documentation, and the systems they'll live in day to day — so they're contributing confidently and correctly.

- Depot Operations Fluency: Teach the team how the depot actually runs: how work flows from intake through repair and release, how their role connects to the technicians and the internal teams upstream and downstream, and what good looks like at each handoff.

- Ongoing Coaching & Mentorship: Provide regular, direct feedback through side-by-sides, one-on-ones, and in-the-moment coaching. Identify where each coordinator wants to grow, build a path for them, and address performance gaps early and honestly.

- Fleet Health & Maintenance Operations

- Fleet Performance Optimization: Monitor and improve key metrics including Mean Time to Recovery, Vehicle Turnaround Time, and Diagnosis Escalation Rate.

- Service Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain quality control processes ensuring all maintenance work meets partner specifications and safety standards.

- Maintenance Planning: Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules, manage maintenance change requests, and ensure compliance with partner fleet management system requirements.

- Technical Problem Resolution: Lead root cause analysis for technical issues working with our 3rd party partner, implementing corrective actions, and developing preventive measures to reduce repeat failures.

- Parts & Materials Oversight

- Service and Parts Coordinator Management: Directly supervise parts and service writing coordination, ensuring seamless integration between parts allocation, work order documentation, and inventory management while maintaining accuracy and compliance standards.

- Supply Chain Coordination: Oversee Material Coordinator activities, ensuring optimal parts inventory levels, secure storage of proprietary components, and compliance with chain of custody standards.

- Inventory Optimization: Analyze parts consumption patterns, forecast requirements, and coordinate with partner aftermarket teams to prevent stockouts while minimizing carrying costs.

- Vendor Parts Management: Manage relationships with parts suppliers, negotiate service agreements, and ensure timely delivery of critical components.

- Non-Conforming Parts Process: Oversee quarantine and disposition procedures for non-conforming parts, ensuring proper documentation and handling.

- Compliance & Documentation

- Training Compliance: Ensure all personnel maintain required qualifications through partner learning management systems, conducting monthly verification reviews per standards.

- Safety Program Integration: Collaborate with the safety team to ensure all maintenance activities comply with EHS requirements, including battery safety, hazardous materials handling, and hot work procedures.

- Documentation Management: Maintain comprehensive documentation hierarchy including job descriptions, safety protocols, training records, and maintenance logs per partner requirements.

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all technical operations meet federal, state, and local regulations including EPA, OSHA, and AV-specific requirements.

- Strategic Planning & Continuous Improvement

- Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, analyzing performance data to identify optimization opportunities and implement best practices across technical operations.

- Capacity Planning: Forecast staffing needs, training requirements, and infrastructure upgrades to support fleet growth and operational scaling.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations Manager, Depot Operations Leads, and partner technical teams to ensure seamless integration of maintenance and depot operations.

- Knowledge Management: Establish and maintain technical knowledge base, documenting lessons learned, best practices, and troubleshooting guides for common issues.

- Culture of Safety:  Champion a comprehensive culture of safety through proactive engagement.  Leading by example in following all safety requirements; educating the team on safety protocols; proactively identifying risks; managing incidents, including reporting and investigation.

- Technical Competencies

- Advanced diagnostic skills for electric and autonomous vehicle systems

- Proficiency with fleet management systems (Carman experience preferred)

- SAP or similar ERP system expertise for parts and maintenance tracking

- Data analysis and reporting capabilities for performance metrics

- Understanding of ISO quality standards and automotive compliance requirements

Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in Automotive Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.

- 4+ years of progressive experience in fleet maintenance management, automotive service operations, or technical training leadership.

- 3+ years of experience managing technical teams including hiring, training, performance management, and development of skilled technicians.

- 2+ years of experience developing and delivering technical training programs, preferably in automotive or fleet maintenance environments.

- Proven expertise in electric vehicle systems, diagnostic procedures, and advanced automotive technologies (AV experience highly preferred).

- Strong understanding of maintenance management systems, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision making for fleet operations.

- Experience with vendor management, contract negotiation, and third-party service provider oversight.

- Demonstrated success implementing quality management systems, safety management systems  and continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean preferred).

- Exceptional communication skills with ability to interface effectively with technical teams, executive leadership, and external partners.

- Current ASE certifications preferred; ability to obtain required partner certifications within 90 days.

- Valid driver's license with clean driving record.

Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

- Subsidized commuter benefits

- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Note : For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.

This role is on-site at a Lyft Flexdrive hub or office location full time. #Onsite
